title: UI System Projection
description: Bounded projection of a backend service/system for the Flutter app's systems view. Published by om-control-plane on ui.systems.index. This is a UI-friendly view of a service — not the full registry record. Clients use this for routine UI; they do not subscribe to raw $SYS.> subjects.

node.description: Node ID where this service runs.

category.description: UI grouping category for the systems view.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary for list views.

actions.description: UI actions available for this system (e.g. restart, stop, view logs). Each maps to a command subject.

command.description: Command subject to publish when action is triggered.

protected.description: Whether this action requires operator approval (e.g. stop/restart).
